theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (w : Euclid n → ℤ) (c : Euclid n → ℝ) (Gh : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (N + 1)) (Ah : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (wh : Euclid (n + 1) → ℤ), MeasurableSet A → Measurable w → Measurable c → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G u) → (∀ u ∈ A, 0 ≤ c u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ z, Gh z = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons (WithLp.ofLp z 0) (WithLp.ofLp (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))))))) → Ah = {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} → (∀ z, wh z = w (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)))) → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1), (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω y) ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in Ah, (wh z : ℝ) * ω (Gh z) (fun a => fderiv ℝ Gh z (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) ≤ ∫⁻ u in A, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w u : ℝ)| * c u)
